paite: Huai lai in Hezekiah si thei ding khop in achi ana hi. Huchi in akiang ah Amoz tapa zawlnei Isai ahong a, "TOUPA'N hichi in achi: Na inkuanpihte omdan ding gelsak in; damkhe lou a si ding na hi ngal a, chi in," achi hi.
heading: Kumpipa Hezekiah Damlouhna Leh Dam Nawnna / (2 Kum 20.1-11; 2 Kro 32.24-26)
english: In those days Hezekiah was sick and near death. Isaiah the prophet, the son of Amoz, came to him, and said to him, “Yahweh says, ‘Set your house in order, for you will die, and not live.’”

paite: Huchi in Hezekiah baang lam nga in akihei a, TOUPA kiang ah athum a,
english: Then Hezekiah turned his face to the wall and prayed to Yahweh,

paite: "TOUPA aw, na ma a thutak leh lungtang hoihkim pu a ka om zeldan leh na mitmuh a thil hoih ka hih zeldan, hehpih in theigige in," achi hi. Huchi in Hezekiah akap huphup hi.
english: and said, “Remember now, Yahweh, I beg you, how I have walked before you in truth and with a perfect heart, and have done that which is good in your sight.” Then Hezekiah wept bitterly.

paite: Huchi in TOUPA thu Isai kiang ah ahong tung a,
english: Then Yahweh’s word came to Isaiah, saying,

paite: "Kuan inla, Hezekiah kiang ah gen in, TOUPA, na pu David Pathian in hichi in achi: Na thumna ka za a, na khituite leng ka mu a; ngai in, na damsung nite ah kum sawm-le-nga ka behlap ding hi.
english: “Go, and tell Hezekiah, ‘Yahweh, the God of David your father, says, “I have heard your prayer. I have seen your tears. Behold, I will add fifteen years to your life.

paite: Huan nang leh hiai khopi Assuria kumpipa a kipan ka humbit ding a; hiai khopi ka hum ding hi.
english: I will deliver you and this city out of the hand of the king of Assyria, and I will defend this city.

paite: "TOUPA'N athil gen ahih ngei ding chih, hiai nang a ding in TOUPA a kipan chiamtehna ding ahi.
english: This shall be the sign to you from Yahweh, that Yahweh will do this thing that he has spoken.

paite: En in, inlim chial a lim, Ahaz dakbi theihna a niamkiaksa, inliim chial sawm tan in ka kiksak nawn ding," achi hi. Huchi in ni niamna dakbi theihna ah inliim chial sawm tan in akik nawnta hi.
english: Behold, I will cause the shadow on the sundial, which has gone down on the sundial of Ahaz with the sun, to return backward ten steps.”’” So the sun returned ten steps on the sundial on which it had gone down.

paite: Judah kumpipa Hezekiah china, adam nawn nung a alaigelh a:
english: The writing of Hezekiah king of Judah, when he had been sick, and had recovered of his sickness:

paite: "Ka damsung nite sun laitak in han kongpi ah lut ding in ka kisa a; ka damsung kum om lai dingte suh in ka omta, ka chi hi.
english: I said, “In the middle of my life I go into the gates of Sheol. I am deprived of the residue of my years.”

paite: TOUPA, TOUPA ngei, mihing gam ah ka mu nawnta kei ding a; khovel a omte lak ah mihing ka mu nawn kei ding hi.
english: I said, “I won’t see Yah, Yah in the land of the living. I will see man no more with the inhabitants of the world.

paite: Ka omna suan in a-om a, belamchingmi puanin bang in ka kiang a kipan a lakmang in a-omta hi. Puan ganmi'n apuan azial bang in ka hinna ka zial a; ama'n siambu a kipan ahon teptan ding a; ni khat leh zan khat thil thu a hon hihtawp maimah ding na hi ve, ka chi hi.
english: My dwelling is removed, and is carried away from me like a shepherd’s tent. I have rolled up my life like a weaver. He will cut me off from the loom. From day even to night you will make an end of me.

paite: Zingsang tan ka dai teitei a; humpinelkai bang in ka guh tengteng ahihtan vek a; nang ni khat leh zan khat thil thu a hon hihtawp mai ding na hi ve.
english: I waited patiently until morning. He breaks all my bones like a lion. From day even to night you will make an end of me.

paite: Lensiam hiam, vakang hiam bang in ka hamham a, vakhu bang in ka thum hi, tunglam etna in ka mit avaita hi; TOUPA aw, nuaisiah a om ka hi, nang ka tang in ding in.
english: I chattered like a swallow or a crane. I moaned like a dove. My eyes weaken looking upward. Lord, I am oppressed. Be my security.”

paite: Bang ka gen dia? Ama'n ahon houpih a, amah mah in ahih pah hi; ka hinna ning kitelna ziak in ka damsung kum teng awl khakha in ka pai khiankhianta ding.
english: What will I say? He has both spoken to me, and himself has done it. I will walk carefully all my years because of the anguish of my soul.

paite: "TOUPA aw, hichibang thil ziak in mihingte ahing zel uh, huaite kia ah ka kha hinna a-om zel hi; huaiziak in hon damsak nawn in hon hingsak nawn in.
english: Lord, men live by these things; and my spirit finds life in all of them. You restore me, and cause me to live.

paite: Ngai in, ka lungmuanna ding in ahi, ning kitelna thupitak ka na neih; himahleh nang, ka hinna na it ziak in, siatna kokhuk a kipan in na humbitta; ka khelhnate tengteng lah na nunglam ah na pai vekta hi.
english: Behold, for peace I had great anguish, but you have in love for my soul delivered it from the pit of corruption; for you have cast all my sins behind your back.

paite: Han in lah hon phat thei ngal kei a, sihna in leng ahon pahtawi thei sam kei hi; kokhuk a kumte'n na thutak alamen thei kei uhi.
english: For Sheol can’t praise you. Death can’t celebrate you. Those who go down into the pit can’t hope for your truth.

paite: Mihing in, mihing in, amau ngei in tuni a ka hih bang in ahon phat ding uh; pa'n atate kiang ah na thutak atheisak ding.
english: The living, the living, he shall praise you, as I do today. The father shall make known your truth to the children.

paite: "TOUPA bel hon hondam ding in amansa gige hi; huaiziak in i damsung tengteng in, TOUPA' inn ah, ka late tumging guineite toh i sa ding."
english: Yahweh will save me. Therefore we will sing my songs with stringed instruments all the days of our life in Yahweh’s house.

paite: Isai in, "Theipi gah lom khat la henla, damdawi atat a tatte ding in ameimatum ah tuamkhum hen, huchi in adam ding," ana chi khinta hi.
english: Now Isaiah had said, “Let them take a cake of figs, and lay it for a poultice on the boil, and he shall recover.”

paite: Hezekiah mah in leng, "TOUPA' inn ah ka hohtou nawn ding chih theihna bang chiamtehna hong om ding ahia?" ana chi khinta hi.
english: Hezekiah also had said, “What is the sign that I will go up to Yahweh’s house?”
